products.title: The Royal Haathi Ivory Linen Tote
products.shortDescription: Signature pure ivory linen tote featuring an ornate royal ceremonial elephant embellished with intricate gold zardozi and jewel-tone borders.
products.description: Inspired by royal Rajasthani heritage and majestic royal processions, The Royal Haathi Ivory Tote is handcrafted from high-density pure Belgian linen fabric in an authentic unbleached natural ivory hue. The centerpiece is a masterfully digitized, high-density embroidered ceremonial elephant (Airavata) embellished with metallic gold zari threadwork, micro-sequin borders, and regal howdah accents. Built with reinforced double-stitched linen handles capable of carrying up to 10kg, a spacious structured interior lined with water-resistant cotton, and secure zipper pockets for modern luxury daily carry.
